200.title: Polish defence minister says supporting Ukraine is in Poland's national interest
200.summary: Polish Defence Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz has stated that supporting Ukraine is in Poland's national interest because it allows Russian missiles and drones to be intercepted before they cross the EU border.
200.body: Polish Defence Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz has stated that supporting Ukraine is in Poland's national interest because it allows Russian missiles and drones to be intercepted before they cross the EU border. Source: Kosiniak-Kamysz during a debate in the Sejm, as reported by Polish 24-hour commercial news channel TVN24 Quote: "Missiles are falling, drones are falling a kilometre from the Polish border. If Ukraine does not have air defence systems, if it does not have ammunition to shoot down these drones, most of them will fly across Ukraine and reach Poland. It is in the national interest to support Ukraine, which is fighting so that missiles can be intercepted there and do not reach Poland." Background: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said that a Russian strike drone crashed near the Polish border in Ukraine's Volyn Oblast on the afternoon of 17 September.

600.body: Photograph: Russell Freeman/EPA View image in fullscreen Australia’s Alex de Minaur roars as he celebrates his Davis Cup win over Kamil Majchrzak of Poland at Brisbane’s Pat Rafter Arena. The world No 9 found top gear on Sunday at Pat Rafter Arena, beating Kamil Majchrzak 6-3, 6-3 to clinch a 3-1 result that sends Australia into the Cup’s penultimate round next year. Australia’s win followed a shock loss on the road to Ecuador earlier this year that plunged them into the must-win encounter against Poland.
